slices.evidence: GrokPassRunner._call_grok strictly enforces allow_online_llm flag before making API requests or using limiters.
GrokPassRunner._call_grok_validated handles routing_plan candidate lists, retries on failure (up to max_candidate_retries), and advances to fallback models on hard failures.
prescan_llm_attempts.json captures granular ExecutionAttempt structures per-model, and is guaranteed to be saved via finally block in PrescanEngine.run().
ProviderLimiter acquired prior to API calls based on est_tokens, and server feedback/429s are correctly adapted.

verification.divergence: test_prescan_route_divergence_recorded and live CLI tests show ladder traversal correctly captures primary failures and fallback successes in the artifact.
verification.fail_closed: test_prescan_no_eligible_route_fails_closed, test_prescan_missing_credential_skips_route, and test_prescan_online_gate_enforced prove fail-closed logic on missing keys, unauth calls, and route exhaustion.
verification.artifact_schema: Grounded payload builders replace mock strings, and BatchResponseValidator checks types before returning LLM responses.

residual_risks: External rate limits may exhaust all ladder routes before a large corpus completes.
